v: Ha in Amós in tik tanhwum in nok' t'a chonhab' Tecoa. Ayik ayoch winhaj Uzías reyal t'a Judá, haxo winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás ayoch reyal t'a Israel, chab' ab'il t'a yalanhtax jun niwan kixkab', ix yalan juntzanh lolonel tik Dios t'ayin yik swalel t'a chonhab' Israel.
Icha sk'anh smak'waj k'u, icha chi' tz'aj yoch sjaj Jehová t'a jolom witz Sion t'a Jerusalén. Masanil swalab' lu'um nok' nok' tz'ixtaxb'ati, stakjipax anh ank'ultak t'a jolom witz Carmelo.
Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ix ek' t'a yib'anh sk'ulan chukal heb' aj Damasco, yuj chi' yowalil ol wak'och syaelal heb', yujto icha tz'aj stek'ji ixim trigo, icha chi' ix utaj heb' aj Galaad yuj heb'.
Yuj chi' ol wak'och sk'ak'al spat heb' rey yinhtilal winhaj Hazael. Ha jun k'ak' chi' ol ak'an lajwokel scuartel winhaj Ben-adad.

Yowalil ol in mak'poj masanil spuertail chonhab' Damasco. Ol wak'an satel masanil heb' kajan t'a sch'olanil Avén yet' heb' yajal t'a Bet-edén. Yuj chi' ol ik'chajb'at heb' sirio preso t'a Quir, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh jantakok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' aj Gaza, yuj chi' yowalil ol wak'och syaelal heb', yujto masanil anima kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Israel ix yik'b'at heb', ix schonhanb'at heb' chekab'wumal t'a Edom.
Yuj chi' ol wak'och sk'ak'al smuroal Gaza chi'. Ha jun k'ak' chi' ol ak'an lajwokel scuartel heb'.

Ol wak' satel heb' ayoch yajalil t'a Asdod yet' pax heb' yajal t'a Ascalón. Yet' masanil in poder ol wak' owal yet' heb' aj Ecrón, manhxa junok heb' filisteo ol to kanok, xchi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh jantakok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' aj Tiro, yuj chi' yowalil ol wak'och syaelal heb', yujto masanil anima kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Israel ix schonhb'at heb' chekab'wumal t'a Edom, majxo snakot jab'ok sti' yak'nak yet' heb' t'a amigoal.
Yuj chi' ol wak'och sk'ak'al smuroal Tiro chi'. Ha jun k'ak' chi' ol ak'an lajwokel scuartel heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh jantakok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' aj Edom, yuj chi' yowalil ol wak'och syaelal heb', yujto ix spech heb' sk'ab' yok heb' chi' yet' k'een espada, haton heb' israel. Ix smak'cham heb' t'a malaj yok'elk'olal, b'ekan sk'ol heb' ix sk'ulan chukal yet' yowal sk'ool. Majxo b'atlaj yowal sk'ol heb' chi' satk'olal yuj.
Yuj chi' ol wak'och sk'ak'al chonhab' Temán. Ha jun k'ak' chi' ol ak'an lajwokel scuartel heb' aj Bosra, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh jantakok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' aj Amón, yuj chi' yowalil ol wak'och syaelal heb'. Ayik ix yak'an owal heb' t'a Galaad yik syik'an jab'okxo slum heb', ix sjak sniwanil heb' ix yab'ix heb'.

Yuj chi' ol wak'och sk'ak'al muro t'a Rabá. Ha jun k'ak' chi' ol ak'an lajwokel scuartel heb'. Ol el yaw heb' wan yak'an owal. Ha t'a skal owal chi' yet' owal ik' ol yamchaj winh sreyal heb' yet' heb' soldado niwak yelk'ochi. Ol ik'jokb'at heb' preso t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh jantakok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' aj Moab, yuj chi' yowalil ol wak'och syaelal heb'. Ix snhustz'a sb'akil winh sreyal Edom heb', taanhxonhej ix ajkan stz'ab'ati.
Yuj chi' ol wak'och sk'ak'al Moab chi'. Ha jun k'ak' chi' ol ak'an lajwokel cuartel t'a Queriot. T'a skal aw yik owal yet' yok' k'een trompeta, ol cham masanil heb' aj Moab chi'.
Ol wak'cham winh sreyal heb' yet' heb' winh ayoch yet' winh t'a yopisio, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh jantakok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' aj Judá, yuj chi' yowalil ol wak'och syaelal heb'. Maj scha yab' in k'ayb'ub'al heb', maj sk'anab'ajej pax in ley heb'. Palta ha t'a juntzanh tas malaj yelk'och b'aj ix yak'em sb'a heb', haton t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'aj yalnak sb'a heb' smam yicham heb'.
Yuj chi' ol wak'och sk'ak'al Judá, haxo jun k'ak' chi' ol ak'an lajwokel cuartel t'a Jerusalén, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh jantakok chukal ix sk'ulej heb' aj Israel tik, yuj chi' yowalil ol wak'och syaelal heb'. Ix schonhel heb' meb'a' heb' wach' spensar t'a skal, yujto max yal stupan sb'ok heb' t'a heb', wach'chom yujnhej stojol jun mojok xanhab'.

Tz'ixtax heb' meb'a' yuj heb', man wach'ok pax syutej heb' sb'oan yaj heb' meb'a' emnakil chi'. K'ixwelal in b'inaj yuj heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yuj schukal heb'. Ha winh mamab'il yet' winh yuninal, junnhej ix kob'es smulan heb' winh yet'ok.

Tz'ek' jichan heb' t'a yib'anh pichul scha b'aj syak' tumin majanil, smulan heb' t'a yichanh junjun altar. Swaan wael heb' tz'altaj t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Sman anh anh heb' yet' k'een multa scha'a, syuk'an anh heb' t'a stemplo juntzanh sdiosal chi', xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová: Ha in Jehová in swala', wak'nak satel heb' amorreo yuj wak'an slum heb' t'ayex. Wach'chom chaanh steel heb' icha steel te' k'ute', tzatz pax heb' icha te' ji, palta junelnhej wak'nak satel heb'.
Palta a ex tik, wik'nakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, wik'annakb'at heb' 40 ab'il t'a tzinan lu'um, yuj wak'an slum heb' amorreo chi' t'a heb'.
Ix wik'chaanh juntzanh heb' eyinhtilal in chekab'ok, haxo juntzanhxo heb', wak'nakoch heb' nazareoal yik tz'och heb' wikok. ¿Tom manh yelok juntzanh tik, ex israel?
Ha exxo tik, ix eyak' pural heb' wikxo chi' yuk'wi anh, ix he kachan heb' in chekab' yik max yalel in lolonel heb'.
Yuj chi' niwan yaelal ol wak'kot t'a eyib'anh, ol ex k'akwok yuj icha snhach'ach'i junok carreta al yaj yuj ixim trigo.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a heb' jelan sb'eyi, manhxo ol yal-laj yel heb', haxo heb' te ay yip, ichato manhxa jab'ok yip heb'. Ha heb' soldado tek'an, manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb'.
Ha mach sjulwaj yet' jul-lab', manhxo ol yal stek'b'an sb'a. Manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb' jelan sb'eyi, manhxo ol yalpax skolan sb'a heb' tz'el lemnaj ayk'e t'a yib'anh nok' chej.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a heb' jelan t'a owal, ol yaktejkan syamk'ab' heb' yik owal, ol b'at heb' elelal, xchi Jehová.
Ex chonhab' Israel, ab'ek tas swal a in Jehová in tik. Ha in ton wik'nakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto.
Ha exnhej tik ix ex in sik'kanel t'a skal masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Yuj chi' ol wak'och eyaelal yuj masanil chukal tze k'ulej.
Tato ay chawanhok junnhej sb'eyi, syalelk'ochi to wach' yak'an heb'.
Tato tz'el yaw nok' choj t'a kaltak te', syalelk'ochi to toxo ix yamchaj schib'ej nok'. Tato tz'el yaw nok' yune' choj t'a swaynub' t'a yoltak nhak'een, syalelk'ochi to ay tas ix yamchaj yuj nok'.
Tato tz'em junok nok' much t'a sat lu'um, syalelk'ochi to ay junok yaal ayemi. Tato sk'e ritnaj jun yaal ayem t'a sat lu'um chi', ay tas toxo ix kan t'ay.
Tato spukhaj k'een trompeta, syak' lista sb'a heb' soldado. Tato ay junok yaelal tzek' t'a skal chonhab', syalelk'ochi to a in swak'koti.
Malaj junok tas tzin k'ulej tato manto wal-laj t'a heb' in chekab'.
Tato tz'el yaw nok' choj, ¿tom ay junok mach max xiwk'ei? Haxo pax heb' in chekab' ¿tom manh ol yalel in lolonel heb' tato a in tzin chek yal heb'? xchi Jehová.
Laj alekel t'a scuartel chonhab' Asdod yet' t'a scuartel chonhab' Egipto: Kotanhek t'a jolomtak witz t'a spatiktak chonhab' Samaria. Ilek wal somchaj heb' anima yuj yixtan yetanimail, xe chi.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh yojtakok jab'ok heb' sk'ulan tojolal. T'a yoltak spat heb' ay masanil tas tonhej syik'ek' heb' t'a anima, xchi Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová, haton Yajal yaji: Ha jun ajk'ol ol jawok ol och hoyan t'a snación heb' tik, ol yak'an lajwokel scuartel heb', ol yik'anelta masanil tas ay t'a yol sdespacho heb', xchi Jehová chi'.

Icha tik yalan Jehová: Icha chab'ok yok nok' kalnel, ma jab'ok snhi' schikin nok' skolchajkanel yuj stanhwumal t'a yol sti' junok nok' choj, icha chi' ol aj heb' israel kajan t'a Samaria, haton heb' te wach' swaynub' b'aj swayi.
Ab'ek a ex tik, tzeyalan t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, a in Jehová Dios, Yajal in t'a Smasanil swala':
Ha t'a jun k'ual ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh Israel yuj chukal sk'ulej, ol in pojem masanil yaltar t'a Betel. Ha schikintak juntzanh altar chi' ol mak'chajem t'a sat lu'um.

Ha in Jehová in swala', ol wak' lajwokem pat sk'anchaj t'a stiempoal siik yet' juntzanh sk'anchaj t'a stiempoal k'ak'. Ol wak' lajwok masanil juntzanh pat ayoch k'een marfil yelwanub'ok, ol in juanb'at juntzanh niwak pat chi', xchi.

Ex ix, b'ak'ech ex yuj he b'eyumal icha nok' wakax t'a Basán, ex kajan ex t'a tzalan yik chonhab' Samaria, ab'ek wal jun tik: Tzeyixtej heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ilb'ajk'ol yilji, tzeyalan t'a heb' winh eyetb'eyum: Ik'ekkot anh anh to skuk'ej anh, xe chi.

Ha Jehová haton Yajal yaji, ix slok sb'i ix yak'an sti', ix yalani: Ol k'och sk'ual, ol ak'chajoch gancho t'ayex, ol ex nherchajb'eyok, haxo heb' eyune', ol och lokan anzuelo t'a heb', ol jachchajb'at heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala', tzololixonhej ol aj eyik'chajel b'aj ol mak'chaj poj pat chi', ol ex ik'chajpaxb'at t'a najat.
Ixikek t'a Betel yet' t'a Gilgal, tzeyak'anoch he mul icha he gana ta'. Slajwi chi' tzeyak'an eyofrenda t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, t'a schab'jial tzeyak'anpax he diezmo.
nhusek ixim pan ay yich t'a ofrendail yuj he ak'oj yuj diosal. Alekel t'a skal anima yuj jantak eyofrenda tz'el t'a he k'ool eyak'ani, yujto icha chi' he gana tze k'ulej.
Yuj chi', ix wak' eyab' syail wejel t'a masanil yol he chonhab' tik, palta manh yujok chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix wak'anoch waan nhab' t'a oxe' ujal ayik manto elul sat eyawb'en. Ix yak' nhab' t'a jun chonhab', haxo t'a junxo, maay. Ay b'aj ix yak' nhab' chi', ay b'aj maay, yuj chi' ix takjiel masanil eyawb'en.
Chab' oxe' chonhab'il ex ix ex b'at sayoj ha' t'a junokxo chonhab', palta maj yab'laj ha' yik tzek' stak'inhal he ti'. Tokwal yuj chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.
Ix wak' eyaelal yet' ik' te k'ak' yet' juntzanhxo yaelal, ix wak'an ixtax tas tzeyawej yet' eyuwa. Haxo nok' k'ulub' ix k'uxanb'at te' eyigo yet' te' eyolivo. Tokwal yuj chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix wak'kot juntzanh yaelal t'a eyib'anh, icha wal ix aj wak'anb'at yaelal t'a Egipto. Ix cham heb' he kelemtak t'a skal owal, haxo heb' eyajk'ol chi' ix ikankan nok' he chej, ix eyab'an sjab' chamnak ayek' t'a he campamento. Tokwal yuj chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.

Ix ex wak' lajwokem icha ix aj wak'an lajwokem chonhab' Sodoma yet' Gomorra, yuj chi' a ex ixto ex kan tik, icha junok kuxk'ak' tz'ik'chajkanelta t'a yol k'ak', icha wal chi' eyaji. Tokwal yuj chi' ix ex meltzajkot t'ayin.
Icha chi' ol ex wutej ex aj Israel. Yuj chi' b'oek he b'a, yujto ol eyil-laj och he sat wet'ok a in he Diosal in tik.

Ha in Jehová in, ix in b'o niwak witz yet' ik', swak'an yojtakejel heb' anima tas nab'il wuuj. Ha in swak' meltzajoch sakil k'inal t'a k'ik'alk'inalil, chaanh tzin b'eyek' t'a yib'anh lum lum. Ha in b'i, haton Jehová Dios, Yajal in t'a Smasanil, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ex wetisraelal, ab'ek wal in lolonel yik kusk'olal swalkanel t'a eyib'anh:

Ha ko chonhab' tik, toxo ix lajwiel yuj owal. Lajan icha junok ix kob'es ix, ix lajwi yuj k'een espada, ix kan telan t'a sat sluum, malaj mach skolani yik sk'e waan. Ix aktajkan sch'okoj t'a slugar, malaj mach tz'ik'ank'e waan.

Ha Jehová Yajal tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Tato a junok he chonhab' tz'ak'anb'at junok mil soldado t'a owal, haxonhej cien ol meltzajok. Tato ay junokxo he chonhab' tz'ak'anb'at cien soldado, haxonhej lajunhwanh ol meltzajok, xchi.
Ha Jehová tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Meltzajanhek t'ayin, yik manh ol ex chamok.

Manh ex b'at t'a chonhab' Betel yet' t'a Gilgal, manh ex b'atpax t'a Beerseba, yujto a heb' aj Gilgal chi', yowalil ol b'atkan heb' preso t'a junok ch'ok nacional, haxo Betel chi', yowalil ol juwokkanb'atok, xchi.
Meltzajanhek t'a Jehová yik manh ol ex chamok. Tato maay, ol yak'kot k'ak' t'a yib'anh he makb'en tik, malaj junok mach t'a Betel ol yal yak'an tupok.
Ha ex wal tze k'ex tojolal t'a chukal, ob'iltak ex, yujto max he b'o yaj heb' anima t'a wach'ilal.

Meltzajanhek t'a Jehová, haton b'oannak k'een k'anal skuchan Mootz yet' pax k'een k'anal skuchan Oxt'ilanh. Ha pax tz'ak'anoch k'ik' k'inal t'a sakil k'inal, syak'paxoch sakil k'inal chi' t'a k'ik'alk'inalil. Haton pax tz'awtan ha ha' ay t'a ha' mar, sekanem t'a yib'anh lum lum.
Ha tz'ak'an lajwokel heb' soldado tek'an, slajwipaxkanem scuartel heb' yuj, Jehová sb'i.
Ob'iltak ex wal, a ex schichonoch he k'ool t'a mach sb'oan tojolal b'aj tz'och b'eyk'olal, tzeyak'an chukal t'a junok tz'ak'an testigoal t'a yel.
To tzeyixtej wal heb' meb'a', tzeyik'anek' strigo heb' anima t'a nab'anhej. Manh ol yal-laj eyajek' t'a he pat b'ob'il t'a k'een k'een, manhxo ol yal pax eyuk'an yal sat te' uwa ix eyawej.

Wojtak jantak juntzanh chukal ix he k'ulej. Manhxalaj slajwub' he mul. Tzeyixtej heb' wach' spensar, tze chaan k'een tumin yik manh wach'ok tzeyutej he b'oan yaj heb' anima. Ha t'a juzgado tzeyak'och t'a yib'anh heb' meb'a' anima wach' spensar.
Yuj chi' a mach ay spensar, tz'em numan, yujto chukxonhej tas tzuji tiknaik.
Manhxo he k'ulej chukal. Ha wach'il tze k'ulej yik wach' manh ol ex chamok. Tato icha chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, t'a wal yel ol ajnhejek' heyet'ok, icha tz'aj eyalan chi'.

Yajekel chukal. Ha wach'il tze xajanej. Scham heyilani tato wach'xo tz'aj sch'olb'itaj yaj anima t'a juzgado. Tekan icha chi' ol ok' sk'ol Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'ayex mach ex yinhtilal ex kan winhaj José.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol och kusk'olal t'a masanil b'ajtak smolb'ej sb'a anima. Ha t'a masanil yoltak calle ol och aw yik yaelal, ol awtaj heb' munlajwum yik tzul ok' heb' yet' heb' yopisio taxon yok'i.
Ayik ol in jawok wak'och yaelal, ol te ok' heb' awum uwa, xchi Jehová.
Ob'iltak wal mach snib'ej sjawi sk'ual yik yowal sk'ol Jehová. ¿Eyojtak hama tas ol ex aj t'a jun k'ual chi'? Ha jun k'ual chi', k'ik' k'inal xonhej ol ajok, manhxa sakil k'inal.

Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', lajan wal ol aj heb' anima icha junok mach tz'el lemnaj t'a junok nok' choj, haxo b'aj ayek' junok nok' oso b'enhej sk'ochi, ma icha yik tz'och junok mach t'a yol spat, tz'och ijan t'a sat k'ilab' yalani, haxo pax junok nok' chan schi'an ta'.
Ha jun k'ual yik yowal sk'ol Jehová chi', te k'ik' k'inal ol ajok, manhxa jab'ok sakil k'inal ol cheklajok.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Tzin yaja', malaj in gana juntzanh k'inh tzeyak'ochi. Malaj in gana t'a he molanil niwan yelk'och eyalani.

Malaj in gana t'a he silab' tzeyak' t'ayin yuj in eyik'anchaanh, malaj in gana t'a ixim trigo tzeyak' eyofrendaok. Max in chapax nok' wakax b'ak'ech tzeyak' silab'il t'ayin yuj he junk'olal wet'ok eyalani.
Najat tzex el t'a in tz'ey ayik tz'och he jaj he b'itani. Manhxa in gana swab' yoch sjaj eyarpa chi'.
Palta a tas in gana t'ayex to tze b'eyb'alej tojolal icha sb'ey ha ha'. Manh eyaktej he k'ulan wach'il icha junok sjaj ha ha' max tupi.
Ha ex wal tik ex israel, ha t'a 40 ab'il ek'nak heb' he mam eyicham t'a lum tzinan lu'um. ¿Tokwal a t'ayin snhusnak silab' heb' yet' ofrenda ta'?

Maay, palta a heb' chi', skuchnak b'eyek' yenhul yib'anh jun sdiosal heb' skuch Moloc yet' sb'akhnub'al yechel jun Dios Quiún yajb'entak, sb'onak yechel k'een k'anal heb' sdiosalok, hanheja' icha chi' tze k'ulej a ex tik.
Yuj chi' ol ex wak'b'at preso t'a yichanhb'at Damasco. Icha chi' tz'aj walan a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ob'iltak ex mach ex sekojtak tz'aj yek' eyuj t'a Sion. Ob'iltak ex malaj tas tze na' t'a Samaria, ex yajalil nación to niwan eyelk'och eyalani, a ex ton tzeyak'och Israel yipok he k'ool.

Ha ex tik tzeyal icha tik: Ixikek t'a chonhab' Calne, tzeyilan sik'lab'il. Haxo ta' tzex b'atpax t'a niwan chonhab' Hamat, tzex emul t'a Gat t'a yol yik heb' filisteo. ¿Tom te wach' juntzanh chonhab' chi' t'a kichanh? ¿Tom te niwak juntzanh nación chi' t'a yichanh ko nación tik? xe chi.
Ha ex tik, malaj he gana tze na'a tato wan sja jun sk'ual yaelal, palta a yuj tas tze k'ulej, wan slak'anb'i ul jun sk'ual yaelal chi'.
Ha ex tik, a b'aj tzex em tz'eyan he wa'i, yelxo te wach' yilji. Niwan wael tzeyak'a' ayik tze chi'an nok' yunetak kalnel yet' nok' kelemtak wakax b'ak'ech.
Tonhej tzek' tiempo he b'oan juntzanh b'it malaj yelk'ochi, tze b'itan yet' sonal te' arpa icha sk'ulejnak winhaj rey David.
T'a yol niwak waso tzeyuk' wino. Ha perfume wach' tze k'ana', palta manh jab'ok tzeyak' pensar tato wan yixtaxel yol he nación.
Ha ex tik, b'ab'el ol ex b'atkan preso t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, icha chi' ol aj slajwiel he k'inh b'aj tzex b'ulb'ulan chi'.

Toxo ix slok sb'i Jehová yak'an sti', haton Yajal t'a Smasanil. Ha tz'alan icha tik: Tzin yaj yik'ojchanhb'ail jun chonhab' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob tik. Manh wal jab'ok scha in k'ol sniwak pat heb', yuj chi' ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool yet' masanil tas ay t'ay, xchi Jehová chi'.
Yuj chi', tato ay lajunhwanhok heb' winh winak t'a junok pat, ol cham heb' winh slajunhwanhil.

Ha junok sk'ab' yok juntzanh chamnak chi' ol ik'anelta sniwanil heb' t'a yol pat yik ol tz'aok, ol yalan t'a yalnhej mach aykan t'a yol chi': ¿Aytom mach ayek' het'ok? xchama. Haxo junxo chi' ol tak'wok: Malaj mach, xchama. Ol yalanpax jun ix k'anb'an chi': Tz'in xa chi, haxo talaj tz'aji, tzak' b'inaj Jehová, xchama.
Yujto ol yak'kot yaelal Jehová t'a yib'anh masanil pat, juntzanh niwak pat yet' juntzanh kotak pat, masanil ol ixtaxkanb'atok.

¿Tom syal sk'e nok' chej t'a sat k'een tenam? ¿Tom syal smunlaj nok' wakax st'okan lu'um t'a yib'anh ha' mar? Palta a ex tik, ix he k'ex tojolal t'a tas tz'ixtanel anima. Ha juntzanh b'eyb'al wach', tzeyala' to chuk.
Ha ex tik, toxonhej tzeyik'chanh he b'a, yujto ix telwi chonhab' Lodebar eyuuj, palta tokwal ay jab'ok yelk'ochi. Tzeyalanpaxi to syal eyuuj, yujto ix eyik' yune' chonhab' Carnaim.

Scham wal eyilan a ex israel ex tik. Ha Jehová Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol in chek junok nación yik syik'ek' he lu'um t'a Hamat t'a yol smojonal t'a stojolal norte, masanto sk'och t'a ha ha' ayoch smojonal t'a stojolal sur, ol ex och t'a syaelal yuj, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ayik toxo ix xikchajel anh b'ab'el sakate yik winh rey, ayik wanxo skotxi swol anh, a Jehová Yajal ix ak'an wila'' to wan yak'an pitzwokk'e nok' k'ulub'.

Ayik wanxo slajwiel anh ank'ultak yuj nok' k'ulub' chi', ix walan icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' a k'ool t'ayonh a onh yinhtilal onhkan winhaj Jacob tik, ina to yune' chonhab' onnhej. ¿Tas wal ol aj stechaj jun tik kuuj? xin chi.
Ix snaan sb'a Jehová yuj jun tik, ix yalan icha tik: --Ha jun tik manh ol ujoklaj, xchi.
Ix sch'oxanpax Jehová Yajal junxo tik t'ayin. Ix yak'lab'ej k'ak' yik syak'anoch yaelal, chak xilinak stzak'ak'il. Ix takji ha' niwan mar yuj, wan stakjipax lum slumal chonhab' Israel.
Ix walani: --Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' a k'ool, ochanh waan. ¿Tom wal ol techaj kuj a onh yinhtilal onhkan winhaj Jacob tik? Ina to yune' chonhab' onh, xin chi.
Ix snaan sb'a Jehová yuj tas nab'il yuj, ix yalan icha tik: --Manh ol ujokpax jun tik, xchi.
Ix sch'oxanpax junxo tik Jehová t'ayin. Ix wilani linhanek' t'a sat jun pat b'ob'il yet' plomo, yub'b'ilpaxk'e jun plomo chi' yuj.

Ix sk'anb'an t'ayin icha tik: --¿Tas tzil chi' Amós? xchi. --Ha jun k'een plomo yik heb' b'oum pat swila', xin chi. --Icha tz'aj yilji junok sat pat yet' k'een plomo, icha chi' ol aj wilani chajtil yilji in chonhab' Israel tik, tato tojol sb'eyb'al, mato maay. Tato chuk, manhxo ol wak' niwank'olal schukal chi'.

Ha juntzanh b'aj syal sb'a heb' yinhtilal winhaj Isaac t'a jolomtak witz, ol lajwokemok. Ha juntzanh stemplo heb' aj Israel, ol juchajemok, ol in chekan satjokel yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yet' k'een espada, xchi Jehová.

Ha winhaj Amasías sacerdote yaj t'a Betel, a winh ix chekan alchaj t'a winhaj Jeroboam sreyal Israel icha tik: Mamin rey, a winhaj Amós, wan yek' winh t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', yik tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayach. Maxtzak techaj yuj heb' anima yuj tas syalel winh chi'.
Tz'ek' winh t'a ko kal yal icha tik: T'a k'een espada ol cham winhaj Jeroboam, ol ik'chajkanb'at masanil chonhab' Israel tik preso t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, xchi winh, xchib'at winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Amasías t'ayin Amós in tik icha tik: --Elanh t'a tik ach schekab' Dios. Ixik t'a Judá, hata' ol ak'chaj a wael yuj tas tzal chi'.
Palta malaj tas tzal t'a chonhab' Betel tik, yujto ha t'a tik tz'och winh rey ejmelal, to niwan templo yaj t'a yol smakb'en winh, xchi winhaj Amasías chi'.
Palta ix in tak'wi Amós a in tik icha tik: --Ha in tik, manh in schekab'oktaxon Dios, malaj pax in gana tzin schekab'ej. Ha in tik tanhwum in wakax, molum in pax sat kaltakte'al higo.
Palta a Jehová ix in ik'anel t'a spatik nok' wakax chi', ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, b'at alel in lolonel t'a in chonhab' Israel, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi' scham wal ab'an slolonel Jehová tiknaik ach Amasías. Haton juntzanh lolonel ix al t'ayin icha tik: Manh alel slolonel Dios t'a skal heb' israel yinhtilal winhaj Isaac, xa chi t'ayin.

Yuj chi' a juntzanh tik syal Jehová t'ayach: T'a yichanh chonhab' ol och ix etb'eyum t'a ajmul ixal. Ha heb' winh uninal yet' heb' ix isilal, ol xikjokcham heb'. Ol pojchajkanek' a lu'um. Haxo t'a slum heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol ach chamok, haxo heb' ketisraelal, najatto ol ik'chajkanb'at heb' preso, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ix sch'ox Jehová wil jun mooch sat awb'en k'inhxo.

Ix sk'anb'an t'ayin icha tik: --¿Tas tzil chi' Amós? xchi t'ayin. --Ha jun mooch sat awb'en k'inhxo swila', xin chi t'ay. Ix yalanxi t'ayin icha tik: --Ha Israel, ichawal to toxo ix k'inhb'i. Manhxo ol wak'xi niwank'olal.

Ayik ol wak'anoch syaelal heb' chi', a heb' ix ix sb'itan t'a spatil heb' yajal, ol ok' heb' ix yuj kusk'olal. Tzijtum anima ol chamok, ol kan teljab' sniwanil heb'. Malaj tas ol ab'chajok, xchi Jehová.
Scham he maklan eyab' juntzanh lolonel tik, mach ex tzeyixtej heb' emnakil yek'i yet' heb' meb'a' t'a chonhab' tik.

Tzeyalan t'a yoltak he pat t'a k'inh ayik tz'alji k'een uj: ¿B'ak'inh ol lajwok yek' jun k'inh tik yik syal ko chonhan ko trigo? ¿B'ak'inh ol lajwok yek' sk'ual ik'oj ip, yik ol yal ko chonhanxi sat kawb'en, ol kak'lab'an echlab' manh tz'akanok, haxo stojol niwan ol ko k'ana'?

Ol ko chonhanpax sk'aelal ixim trigo. Ol kixtej juntzanh heb' meb'a' tik, masanto ol yal schonhanel sb'a heb' t'ayonh, yik tz'och heb' ko chekab'ok. Icha chi' ol aj stupanel sb'ok heb' t'ayonh, wach'chom jab'nhej sb'ok heb' chi' icha stojol jun mojok xanhab', xe chi.
Yuj chi' ix yak' sti' Jehová sDiosal winhaj Jacob, ix yalan icha tik: Malaj b'ak'inh ol b'at he chukal satk'olal wuuj, xchi.
Yuj chi' ol ib'xokk'e lum lum, ol ok' masanil heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um. Masanil jun chonhab' tik ol ib'xokk'ei, ol k'e lum t'a chaanh, ol empax lu'um icha tz'aj ha' Nilo, sk'ib'k'e ha', stupxiem ha'.
Ha in Jehová in swal yuj jun k'ual chi': T'a chimk'ualil, ol wak'em k'u, ol och k'ik' k'inal t'a k'ualil.

Ha in ol wak'och sk'ual he k'inh t'a kusk'olal. Haxo he b'it yuj tzalajk'olal ol wak'och t'a ok'el yuj chamel. Haxo pichul yik kusk'olal ol eyak'ochi, ol he joxanel xil he jolom yuj he ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Ol ex ok' icha junok mach tz'ok' yuj junok k'otanh yuninal ix chami. Kusk'olal ol aj slajwi masanil.
Ay wal jun k'ual ol wak'kot wejel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Manh wejelok yuj wael, manh takinhtialok yuj ha ha', palta wejel yik tz'ab'chaj in lolonel. Ha in Jehová Syal Wuj Masanil, a in swala'.

Ha heb' anima, toxonhej ol b'eyek' heb' sayanek' mach tz'alan in lolonel. Ol b'at heb' t'a stitak ha' mar Muerto, masanto ol k'och heb' t'a stitak ha' mar Mediterráneo, ol ek'chaj heb' t'a schanhil pak'anh yol yib'anhk'inal, palta malaj mach ol ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a heb' ix kob'estak te wach' yilji yet' heb' kelemtak te tek'an, ol el yip heb' yuj takinhtial.

Icha chi' ol aj heb' syak' sti' t'a juntzanh yechel k'ixwelaltak ay t'a Samaria, haton heb' tz'alan icha tik: Swak' in ti' t'a sb'i sdiosal heb' aj Dan, ma t'a sb'i sdiosal heb' aj Beerseba, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' manhxa b'ak'inh ol k'e waan heb', xchi Jehová.

Haxo ix wilani ayek' Jehová t'a stz'ey jun altar, ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Mak' yoyal templo tik, masanto tz'ib'xik'e sjolom yoyal chi', tz'em weknaj t'a yib'anh heb' anima. Tato ayto mach skani, haxo yet' k'een espada ol wak'cham heb'. Wach'chom olto snael sb'a heb', palta manhxo junok mach olto kolchajkanelok.
Wach'chom sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a sjulal yich b'aj ay heb' chamnak, ol yal wik'ank'eta heb' ta'. Wach'chom sk'e heb' t'a satcha'anh yalani, palta hata' ol wik'emta heb'.

Tato sb'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a jolom witz Carmelo, palta hata' ol b'at in yamkot heb'. Tato sb'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'ayin t'a yich ha' mar yalani, ol in chekb'at nok' niwak nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar chi', yik schijib'at heb' yuj nok'.
Wach'chom ol ex yik'b'at heb' ajk'ol t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, ol b'at ex in chek xikjokcham yet' k'een espada. Ol wak'anb'at yaelal t'a eyib'anh, manhok wach'ilal ol wak'b'ati, xchi Jehová.
Ayik syaman lum lum tik Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, tz'ib'xik'e lu'um, haxo heb' anima smasanil, tz'ok'k'e heb'. Toxonhej sk'ei tz'em lum yuj spoder, icha wal syutej sb'a ha' Nilo.
Ha t'a satcha'anh ix sb'o skajnub', ichato t'a yib'anh lum lum tik ix sb'oem yich. Syawtejkot ha ha' t'a ha' mar yik skot seknaj ha' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik. Jehová ton sb'i.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha t'a yol in sat a ex israel ex tik, lajan ex yet' heb' aj Etiopía. Icha ix aj ex wik'ankot t'a Egipto, icha pax chi' ix aj wik'ankot heb' filisteo t'a Creta yet' heb' amorreo t'a Quir, xchi.
Ha in Jehová in swil jun nación te chuk tik, swalan icha tik: Ol in satel t'a sat lum lum tik. Palta a in Jehová in swala' to manh ol in satel-laj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob tik t'a junelnhej.
Ol in chek chayjok heb' yinhtilal Israel tik t'a kaltak nación, ichawal tz'aj schaychaj ixim trigo t'a yol chaylab' to malaj junok sat ixim tz'eli.

Masanil heb' chuk t'a in chonhab' tik, ol xikjokcham heb' t'a k'een espada, haton heb' tz'alan icha tik: Ha juntzanh yaelal chi', manh ol jalaj t'a kib'anh, manh ol onh yamchaj yuj, xchi heb', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová: Ha yopisio winhaj David ix lajwiem icha junok pat jub'ilemi, palta ay jun k'ual ol in b'oxik'ei. Ol wak'anpax yopisio winh t'a yinhtilal, icha t'a peka'.

Ichato chi', a jantakto heb' aj Edom olto kanok yet' masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' to wiktaxoni, ol ochkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' yinhtilal Israel, xchi Jehová Jun ix ak'ankan slolonel, ol yak'anpax elk'ochok.

Syalxi Jehová: Ol jawok stiempoal ayik manto lajwi sjochchaj ixim trigo, ol k'och pax stiempoal st'okchajxi lu'um yik tz'awchaj ixim junelxo. Manto lajwi stek'chajel yal sat te' uwa, tz'ochxi awoj trigo junelxo. Haxo t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkixtak, ol ste ak'ej sat te' uwa, ol b'ey yal sat te' icha sjaj ha ha',

yujto ol wik'kot in chonhab' Israel b'aj ayb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol laj sb'oanxi schonhab' heb' juwinakemi, yik skajnajxi heb' t'ay, ol yawanxi yuwa heb', ol yuk'an wino heb'. Ol yawan te' awb'en te' heb', ol sloan sat te' heb'.
Ha in Jehová Dios in swala', ol wak'xi kajnaj heb' t'a sluum. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol el heb' junelxo t'a sat slum ix wak' chi', xchi Jehová.
